init.title: MikroTik Manager options
init.description:
**Webhook push.** In the manager go to Settings → Alerting → Outbound webhooks, add this URL and tick the events you want (for instance device_offline and device_online). The manager only posts to public addresses, so the URL must be reachable from outside your LAN (Nabu Casa or a reverse proxy):

`{webhook_url}`

If you set a secret in the manager, enter the same one below and unsigned or wrongly signed requests are rejected. Leave it empty to accept any post. Events fire `mikrotik_manager_event` on the HA bus.

**Throughput sensors** need a manager with /api/metrics/interfaces/latest; ports become rx/tx bit-rate sensors.
